content.short: Dmail Network provides private, encrypted, and decentralized e-mails and workspaces.
content.description: Dmail Network offers two core capabilities: a user inbox powered by IPFS and Canister that lets users manage and access their data themselves. It also provides a collaborative workspace where the high-frequency Dmail communication service acts as a central portal for messages, assets, and workspace data, helping teams coordinate communications, share resources, and organize projects. This combination supports organized messaging and data management in a single, coherent environment.
